Bitwarden Patched

Patched builds of the open-source Bitwarden Android app (unofficial fork, not affiliated with Bitwarden Inc.).

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://mkalmousli.github.io/BitwardenPatched/repo
